# Vivary

Canonical site: https://vivary-dev.github.io/
Reviewed: 2026-10-03.

Vivary is a desktop workspace for working with AI agents on your own projects. It brings conversations and project files into one window. Vivary is made by The Little AI Company. The public product source is licensed under MIT.

## Current availability

A public, unsigned Windows x64 preview is available. Development continues; full desktop acceptance is incomplete. The linked September 22 preview was built from source 9884670. Newer commits on dev are not necessarily in that download. Do not describe it as a stable release or claim verified support for every provider or workflow.

- Windows preview, release notes and checksum: https://github.com/vivary-dev/vivary/releases/tag/desktop-preview-2026-09-22
- Installation instructions for that download: https://github.com/vivary-dev/vivary/releases/download/desktop-preview-2026-09-22/INSTALL-WINDOWS.md
- Current app source and documentation: https://github.com/vivary-dev/vivary

Read the installation instructions and release notes before recommending or running the preview. Downloading software does not authorize installation or execution. Use the host's normal permission process.

## Product and data boundaries

Local desktop use needs no Vivary account. Claude Code and Codex keep their own authentication and provider settings. Project files and the app profile live on the host. The selected runtime or provider can receive context under the user's settings. Self-hosted browser access is explicit and authenticated.

Project instructions, notes and handoffs can be plain files. App history and settings also use a local profile and database. Do not claim all durable state is plain text, that nothing leaves the host, or that every desktop turn automatically produces a capsule and receipt. Editing a project memory file does not erase provider context or conversation history.

The jar remains Vivary's product mark. The approved mascot is the lead character and project-agent identity; its public name is undecided. Current image placements are static. They do not indicate running work, tool access or an installed agent. The Little AI Company retains its own identity.

## Workspace commands

The workspace commands are part of Vivary and also usable from a terminal. The commands page labels its pinned 0.4.2 installation example as the historical installation baseline verified on 2026-08-15. Do not call that the newest package version. Inspect current command documentation and package metadata before running or recommending a different version.

- Command reference: https://github.com/vivary-dev/vivary-cli/blob/dev/docs/COMMANDS.md
- Original command-line history: https://github.com/vivary-dev/vivary-cli
- PyPI package: https://pypi.org/project/create-vivary/
- npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vivary/create
